src = open('tests/test_optimizer.py').read()
marker = "# ---- randomized valid documents ----"
head = src.split(marker)[0]
tail = '''# ---- randomized valid documents ----
LABELS = ['x', 'y', 'z', 'w', 'q']
ORIGINS = ['.', 'test.', 'a.test.', 'sub.test.', 'deep.sub.test.', 'z.a.test.', 'ex.test.']
TARGETS = ['end.test.', 'z.sub.test.', 'out.example.', 'a.test.', 'test.', 'sub.test.']
seed = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 7
trials = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 300
valid_docs = 0
for trial in range(trials):
    rng = random.Random(trial * 9773 + seed)
    origins = rng.sample(sorted(set(ORIGINS)), rng.randint(0, 4))
    zones = []
    for origin in origins:
        recs = []
        owner_type = {}
        for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 5)):
            if origin == '.' and rng.random() < 0.2:
                owner = '*.'
            elif rng.random() < 0.15:
                owner = '*.' + origin
            else:
                chain = '.'.join(rng.choice(LABELS) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 3)))
                owner = chain + '.' + origin
            if owner == origin or owner in owner_type:
                continue
            if rng.random() < 0.3:
                owner_type[owner] = 'CNAME'
                recs.append(rec(owner, 'CNAME', rng.choice(TARGETS)))
            else:
                rtype = rng.choice(['A', 'AAAA', 'TXT'])
                owner_type[owner] = rtype
                for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 2)):
                    if rtype == 'A':
                        recs.append(rec(owner, 'A', '192.0.2.%d' % rng.randint(0, 255)))
                    elif rtype == 'AAAA':
                        recs.append(rec(owner, 'AAAA', '2001:db8::%x' % rng.randint(0, 255)))
                    else:
                        recs.append(rec(owner, 'TXT', rng.choice(['hi', 'v2', 'A'])))
        zones.append({'origin': origin, 'records': recs})
    profiles = [prof('p%d' % i, rng.choice([0, 1, 2, 3, 64]),
                     rng.choice(['follow', 'stop']), rng.choice(['rfc', 'off', 'one-label']))
                for i in range(rng.randint(1, 6))]
    queries = []
    for qi in range(rng.randint(0, 9)):
        base = rng.choice(ORIGINS)
        chain = '.'.join(rng.choice(LABELS) for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 3)))
        name = (chain + '.' if chain and chain != 'root' else '') + base
        if rng.random() < 0.1:
            name = '*.' + name
        queries.append(query('q%d' % qi, name, rng.choice(['A', 'AAAA', 'TXT', 'CNAME']),
                             rng.randint(1, 20)))
    doc = {'zones': zones, 'profiles': profiles, 'queries': queries, 'observations': []}
    if verify_doc('random trial %d' % trial, doc):
        valid_docs += 1

print('valid documents exercised: %d/%d' % (valid_docs, trials))
sys.exit(c.done('optimizer cross-check'))
'''
open('tests/test_optimizer.py','w').write(head + tail)
print('rewritten')
